author: freeCodeCamp.org
description: AI tools have made a lot of progress, but they're still not quite there for technical writing. They can make mistakes, get the tone wrong, fail to recognize important context, and so on. Ihechikara - who has done his fair share of technical writing and editing - talks about this with Quincy on the freeCodeCamp podcast.
title: Why humans are still necessary in the technical writing and research process
